item.title: Artadia Awards 2026: 21c Museum Hotels Roving Award
item.description:
Organisation: Artadia (with 21c Museum Hotels)

Location: 21c Museum Hotels partner cities, United States

Award: Three Awardees each receive a US$15,000 unrestricted award; Finalists not chosen receive an honorarium. Plus Artadia Network access and Artist Registry webpage. No application fee.

Duration: One-off roving award; two-round jury (review + virtual studio visits)

Deadline: Closed 15 Jul 2026

Artadia's roving Award in collaboration with 21c Museum Hotels, providing unrestricted financial support to contemporary visual artists in cities where 21c has a presence (e.g. Louisville, Cincinnati, Bentonville, Durham, Kansas City, Lexington, Nashville, Oklahoma City, Chicago, Saint Louis). Three Awardees receive $15,000 each (use freely); Finalists receive an honorarium. Process and general eligibility match Artadia's standard rules (two-year residency in the relevant city, contemporary visual-arts practice, not a student, no prior Artadia award of $10,000+). Open call 15 June - 15 July 2026. Apply via Submittable only; check Artadia's FAQ for the specific 21c eligible cities for this cycle.

item.title: XENO Prize for Artists' Books
item.description:
Organisation: Franklin Furnace

Location: United States.

Award: USD 5,000 to one artist to publish one book on the topic of book banning and/or burning, in an edition of at least 100 copies.

Duration: One-time prize

Deadline: Closed 04 Jul 2026

In pursuit of its mission to present, preserve, interpret, educate, and advocate on behalf of avant-garde art, especially forms that may be vulnerable due to institutional neglect, cultural bias, their ephemeral nature, or politically unpopular content, Franklin Furnace offers the annual XENO Prizes for Artists' Books. One artist will receive USD 5,000 to publish one book on the topic of book banning and/or burning in an edition of at least 100 copies. Deadline: July 4, 2026.

item.title: BMI Foundation Babyface Award 2026
item.description:
Organisation: BMI Foundation

Location: USA; remote application.

Award: $10,000 career grant plus artistic and business mentorship. No application fee.

Duration: One-time award.

Deadline: Closed 30 Jun 2026

The BMI Foundation Babyface Award is an inaugural annual award supporting emerging songwriters working in R&B, hip-hop, soul, and music of the African diaspora. Founded with a $25,000 investment from Wells Fargo. AMOUNT: $10,000 career grant plus artistic and business mentorship. ELIGIBILITY: ages 18-29 as of 30 June 2026; US residents or those in US territories; submitted works must be unpublished and unassigned to major labels or publishers (self-released works are eligible); co-written works are eligible if all writers meet the eligibility criteria (maximum 3 writers; award split evenly). One application per person per year; cannot submit the same work to multiple BMI Foundation programs. No affiliation with BMI required. APPLICATION MATERIALS: a 1-2 minute personal statement video; two audio files with anonymized lyric sheets (lyrics may be in any language with English translation); and a description of the creative process (audio, visual, or written format). No application fee. Apply via Google Form at https://bmifoundation.org/by-application/babyfaceaward. Deadline: 30 June 2026.

Open call details

item.title: Artadia Awards 2026: San Francisco Bay Area
item.description:
Organisation: Artadia

Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States

Award: Three Awardees each receive a US$15,000 unrestricted award. Finalists not chosen as Awardees receive an honorarium. Awardees also access the Artadia Network and the Online Artist Registry. No application fee.

Duration: One-off award; two-round jury (application review + virtual studio visits)

Deadline: Closed 01 Jun 2026

Artadia's open call for the San Francisco Bay Area, providing unrestricted financial support, exposure and recognition to contemporary visual artists. Three Awardees receive $15,000 each (use freely); Finalists not chosen as Awardees receive an honorarium. Awardees join the Artadia Network and get a dedicated webpage on the Artadia Online Artist Registry. PROCESS: open call (May 1 - June 1, 2026); first-round jury of three curators (one local) selects six Finalists; second-round jury conducts 45-minute virtual studio visits; three Awardees announced. ELIGIBILITY: contemporary visual artist making work for a contemporary-art context; living and working in the Bay Area's eligible counties and resident there for 2+ consecutive years prior to the deadline; not currently enrolled (or planning to enrol) in an art-related degree programme; have never received an Artadia/Art Council award of $10,000 or more (former finalists may re-apply). Apply via Submittable only.
